blocks.text: Mission West homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Mission West, September 2026. Detached houses: 5 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 20%. Condos and townhomes: 8 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 2 sold over 4 months against an average of 8.0 listed, about 16.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 1 sold. Condos and townhomes: 2 sold over 4 months against an average of 6.5 listed, about 13.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 2 sold.

faq.q: Is Mission West part of the City of Mission?
faq.a: Yes — the Mission West board sub-area (Silverdale and the western rural fringe toward Stave Falls) sits inside the City of Mission, so City planning, zoning and tax rules apply; Silverdale is defined in the City's Official Community Plan as the 3,440-acre Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area designated for urban growth.

faq.q: How did Mission West sell in September 2026?
faq.a: On very small counts: 5 detached listings with 1 sold (a 20% sales ratio — the highest published detached ratio in Mission that month, but resting on a single sale, so treat it with a small-count caution) and 8 Condos & Townhomes listings with 0 sold; no sub-area median is published for Mission West, and Mission's community medians (detached $814,000; attached $430,000) are not Mission West figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What is the Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area?
faq.a: The City of Mission's 3,440-acre planning area in southwest Mission (sometimes known as Southwest Mission), designated in the Official Community Plan for urban growth and being planned through a Central Neighbourhood Plan and a Master Infrastructure Strategy.

faq.q: When are property taxes due on a Mission West home?
faq.a: To the City of Mission: for 2026, City of Mission property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026, and a 10% penalty was added to any current balances outstanding, including unclaimed home owner grants, on July 3, 2026.
